fit_scaling_law: fit a power law scaling model to LLM finetuning data points and loss values using BFGS optimization
evaluate_scaling_law: evaluate a scaling law function with given data points and parameters to predict loss values
build_scaling_law_pipeline: build a pipeline that fits a scaling law to training data and evaluates predictions on new points
refactor_scaling_law_func: refactor the scaling law function to support additional parameter forms or multi-output scenarios
review_fit_scaling_law: review the fit scaling law function for optimization convergence and parameter initialization strategies
